annotations.title: Brand sentiment, news sentiment: headlines with sentiment scores

description: Brand sentiment from the news on a topic in one call: the latest headlines from the Brave News index (title, URL, publisher, age), each with a positive or negative score from a DistilBERT model, and the balance across them. Up to 10 articles from the past day, week or month. Not a market signal. Results are for the caller's immediate use only (Brave API terms). Use for a market mood check, brand monitoring or a news brief. Example: q=bitcoin. Price $0.03/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits); failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

freshness.description: Only articles from the past day, week or month (default: week)
